top_signals.title: US Tech Stocks Lift S&P 500, Nasdaq After Nvidia’s Outlook Beat
top_signals.summary: A blockbuster outlook from chip darling Nvidia Corp. is providing a boost to tech stocks and lifting key equity indexes Thursday morning, adding to investor optimism about the AI cycle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Alphabet Loses $700 Billion in Market Value as AI Questions Rise
top_signals.summary: For much of the last year, Alphabet Inc. has been the Big Tech stock to beat as investors bet that it was the most-likely winner from the artificial intelligence boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ripple Prime expands into US equity derivatives with Delta One business
top_signals.summary: Institutional clients can access total return swaps across linked to US-listed equities, indexes and digital assets and cross-margin exposures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary: Guidance for central government and local government preparers for Whole of Government Accounts.

top_signals.summary: Bipedal robots may look impressive doing tricks on YouTube, but the real value lies with their less flashy, highly functional industrial cousins
